title: Hedge Desk Basis Note: What a Roll Costs the Member on Grain Marketing Contracts
content:
The charge a roll carries on Grain Marketing Contracts is the chargeable bushels times the roll rate the member is worked at, taken at the desk multiple, and the roll rate the member is worked at is the base roll rate plus the repeat surcharge.

**The bushels.** The chargeable bushels are the bushels the roll moves less the crop-year roll allowance, never below zero, and the bushels the roll moves are the bushels the signed roll instruction names.

**The four figures brought to them.** The base roll rate is the administrative charge per bushel the member's marketing programme carries. The repeat surcharge is nil. The crop-year roll allowance is nil. The desk multiple is one.

**Rounding.** The charge is rounded to the cent once, on the figure reached after the chargeable bushels, the roll rate and the desk multiple have been multiplied together, and not at any earlier point.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

A signed roll instruction names 8,000 bushels. Assume a hypothetical administrative charge of 0.04 per bushel on the member's marketing programme.

| Step | Hypothetical figure |
|---|---|
| Bushels the roll moves, being the bushels the instruction names | 8,000 |
| Crop-year roll allowance taken off them | nil |
| Chargeable bushels | 8,000 |
| Base roll rate | 0.04 per bushel |
| Repeat surcharge added to it | nil |
| Roll rate the member is worked at | 0.04 per bushel |
| Chargeable bushels times that rate | 320.00 |
| Taken at the desk multiple of one | 320.00 |

The charge is 320.00, rounded to the cent at that single point.
